details.description: Gemma 7B is the base, pretrained (non-instruction-tuned) 7-billion-parameter model in Google's first-generation Gemma family of lightweight open-weight models, built from the same research as Google's Gemini models, per Google's model card. It is a decoder-only, text-to-text model trained on roughly 6 trillion tokens of English-language web documents, code, and mathematical text, over an 8,192-token context window, intended as a foundation for further fine-tuning or research rather than for direct chat use. Google's current Gemma documentation lists Gemma 4 as the newest generation and groups this first-generation model among "previous Gemma models," though its weights remain downloadable; Google separately offers an instruction-tuned "gemma-7b-it" model for chat use.
advantages: Scores 64.3 on MMLU (5-shot) and 46.4 on GSM8K (maj@1), per Google's Gemma model card.
Scores 32.3 on HumanEval (pass@1) and 81.2 on HellaSwag (0-shot), per Google's Gemma model card.
Open weights available for download and local fine-tuning, per Google's model card.
disadvantages: This is the base, non-instruction-tuned checkpoint; Google offers a separate gemma-7b-it model specifically tuned for chat and instruction-following.
Superseded by three newer Gemma generations; Google's documentation now lists Gemma 4 as the current generation and groups this model under "previous Gemma models."
Trained and documented for English-language use only, per Google's model card.
use_cases: Base model for further fine-tuning on downstream tasks
Research into language model behavior and NLP experimentation

notes: The slug has no '-it' suffix and Fireworks' catalog entry is the base/pretrained checkpoint (Google publishes a separate gemma-7b-it for chat use); described and scored accordingly even though Bud serves it under a chat endpoint. Google's current docs now group Gemma 1 under 'previous Gemma models' with Gemma 4 listed as current, though no formal deprecation date is given for Gemma 1 itself.
